column1: # AUTHORED, CURATION SEED. Pathogen status for species that carry a genus-level
# pathogen prior but NO species-rank evidence (Tier C). The genus prior CANNOT be
# inherited: this set mixes real pathogens with biocontrol/mycoparasite yeasts in
# pathogen genera (e.g. Ampelomyces quisqualis, Moesziomyces spp.), which is exactly
# why each needs a literature decision. detect.py reads STATUS as an override on the
# PHI-base/FUNGuild logic; leave it BLANK rather than guess.
# TO CURATE: status  host  evidence_id  note
#   status      pathogen | resident | mycoparasite | biocontrol | saprotroph | unclear
#   host        plant host(s) it is a pathogen OF, if pathogen; blank otherwise
#   evidence_id DOI or URL behind the decision
#   note        one line, the quoted basis
# PRIOR columns (ft_*, usda_*, if_status) are decision SUPPORT from holobase, not a
# verdict. ft_* is GENUS-level (FungalTraits); usda_* is species-level occurrence.
